description: Apply an organization-wide adjustment to every member's hourly COST rate, effective from a date. Supply EITHER adjustment_percentage (e.g. 5 to raise all rates by 5%, -3 to cut 3%) OR fixed_amount (set every rate to this exact amount), not both. The organization is fixed by your context - never pass an organization id. Rate values are never echoed back.

adjustment_percentage.description: Percentage to adjust every rate by (e.g. 5 = +5%, -3 = -3%). Provide this OR fixed_amount, not both.

effective_from.description: Date the adjusted rates take effect (YYYY-MM-DD) (required).

fixed_amount.description: Set every rate to this exact amount. Provide this OR adjustment_percentage, not both.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: bulk_update_cost_rates
